provenance.availability_rule: u = numpy.random.default_rng(seed).random(n_assets) drawn once per seed; asset i is short-unavailable at haircut h when u_i < h; unavailable short positions are dropped, never re-levered; rows whose short book is wiped out are flattened and reported via per_seed_degenerate_rows
provenance.cost_rule: costed_pnl_t = baseline_book_pnl_t - haircut * mean_baseline_short_gross; baseline_book_pnl and mean_baseline_short_gross are the haircut-0 book quantities for that weighting/variant, so the fee term is seed-invariant and costed_sharpe is non-increasing in haircut by construction; the availability effect is isolated in availability_sharpe
provenance.haircut_semantics: borrow/availability stress: P22 WP2 owns nonlinear market impact; this ladder is not a price-impact model
provenance.note: Controlled synthetic stimulus with known ground truth: not real market data and not market profitability evidence.
provenance.recovery_estimator: recovery = w_bar @ alpha where w_bar is the mean active-row weight vector of the availability-restricted book and alpha is the planted/null alpha from universe.json
